tools.name: search_names
tools.description: Lists the domain names rentadomain.sh has for rent right now, each with its monthly price and term menu; call it first, or whenever the user wants a domain and has not named one.

tools.name: get_name
tools.description: Looks up one domain name on rentadomain.sh: listed, rented or not held, the monthly price for 12, 6 and 1 month terms, the renewal floor and ceiling, the appraisal and the rent URL; call it when the user names a specific domain.

tools.name: get_lease_terms
tools.description: Returns the exact lease text for one name and term, its version and sha256, and the never-sell guarantee in one sentence; call it before the human rents, so they read what they sign.

tools.name: how_to_rent
tools.description: Returns the exact steps for this agent and its human to rent a name and point its DNS, with every URL; call it once the user has picked a name.

tools.name: start_rent
tools.description: Starts renting one listed name for a term (12, 6 or 1 month) and returns an approval_url for the human to open: they sign in (an email code, then a passkey or authenticator app), pass the identity check, sign the lease and pay by card, and the fixed-term lease starts on payment with no refunds after

tools.name: get_rent_status
tools.description: Reports where a rent started by start_rent stands: waiting (the human has not opened approval_url), signing, active (with the lease and its dashboard URL), failed, expired, or taken (someone else rented the name first). Poll it after handing over approval_url.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_name, start_rent, get_rent_status · Public sink: start_rent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_name, start_rent, get_rent_status · Public sink: start_rent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
